project.name: Abetifi Stone Age Community Development
project.objective: Turn deep archaeological evidence and a proposed community museum into a transparent public platform for stewardship, learning and partnership.
project.audience: Community members, traditional leaders, visitors, schools, researchers, institutions, grantmakers, sponsors and mission-aligned funders.
project.governing_idea: The landscape is read in layers: evidence below, shared value in the present and a proposed institution above.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Warm stone, botanical greens and excavated strata create an editorial interface that feels rooted in place without simulating an archaeological reconstruction.

palette.contrast: dark landscape fields transition into warm paper-like evidence surfaces

creative_system.composition: Oversized editorial typography, deliberate negative space, radial museum geometry and layered landscape contours.
creative_system.camera: A restrained forward drift through mist and stone with no synthetic whip pans or orbiting spectacle.
creative_system.lighting: Soft overcast plateau light with warm mineral accents and readable foreground contrast.
creative_system.typography: A high-contrast old-style display face paired with compact Geist labels and generous responsive spacing.
creative_system.motion: Slow cinematic landscape drift and scroll reveals with complete reduced-motion parity.
creative_system.sound: No autoplay audio; the web derivative is intentionally silent.
creative_system.interface: Keyboard-operable navigation, floor tabs, cost explorer and stakeholder tools with semantic headings and visible focus states.
invariants: Separate established evidence, interpretation, proposed works and future concepts.
Keep the generated landscape visibly disclosed as interpretive rather than documentary.
Present the preliminary BOQ as under review and never as a verified funding gap or financial return.
permitted_variations: Collapse radial and multi-column structures into clear vertical sequences on small screens.
Replace video with the poster and static contour system where motion is unavailable.

elements.name: Distant visitors
elements.description: A small, non-identifiable group used only to establish human scale in the interpretive landscape.

elements.name: Interpretive plateau landscape
elements.description: Mist-softened forest ridges, a restrained sandstone shelter form and human-scale visitors with negative space for the editorial title.

scenes.title: Deep history, shared future
scenes.summary: Establish the plateau as a living landscape before the interface opens into evidence and stakeholder pathways.

shots.purpose: Create an immediate sense of scale, age and invitation without claiming documentary authenticity.
shots.action: Mist moves gently across sandstone and forest while distant visitors walk into the landscape.
shots.composition: Wide 16:9 landscape with the geological form on the right and title space on the left.
shots.lighting: Soft overcast daylight with warm mineral stone.
shots.motion: Subtle atmospheric and visitor movement only.
shots.vfx: Naturalistic mist; no archaeological objects, inscriptions or fantasy effects.
shots.audio: Silent web derivative for muted autoplay.
continuity: preserve sandstone geometry, palette, mist and human scale

deliverables.title: Abetifi Stone Age public platform
deliverables.alt_text: Bosumpra heritage and proposed museum platform for Abetifi, Ghana

rights_and_claims.description: The hero video and poster are newly generated and visibly disclosed as an interpretive visualization.
rights_and_claims.evidence: Higgsfield job 4f10966a-4494-42b7-a894-51df8bd654f6 and local generation record.

rights_and_claims.description: The supplied papers inform original summaries and data visualizations; publisher photographs, maps and figures are not republished.
rights_and_claims.evidence: Public experience contains citations and recreated factual diagrams only.

review_notes: Landscape motion is progressive enhancement; the complete experience remains usable without it.
No bookings, donations or regulated investment transactions are enabled without verified organizational details.

assumptions: Bosumpra Heritage Park is used as a descriptive public label while the legal entity remains Abetifi Stone Age Community Development Park LBG.
All visitor expressions of interest remain non-transactional until an official contact and operating plan are supplied.
open_questions: Confirm final public naming, official contact channel, governance and registration details.
Confirm land title or survey area, architectural approvals and a reissued quantity-surveyor estimate.
risks: Project-source claims may be mistaken for independently verified current facts if status labels are removed.
Donations or investment solicitation should not launch before legal, payment and governance controls are approved.
